outcome: Immune cell populations (CD56+CD16+/CD56+CD16, macrophages, Treg cells, B lymphocytes)
cohort: The study included 26 healthy pregnant women scheduled for elective cesarean section at the First Affiliated Hospital of Jinan University.
finding: Placental microbiota stimulates local placental immunity and maternal systemic immunity by affecting immune cell populations and cytokine content.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, at term, at the time of elective cesarean section
